tool.name: toolkit
tool.description: Read-only clikit surface for nanogo tutor/admin reporting commands.

retry_behavior.true_action: retry read-only status commands after a short delay
retry_behavior.false_action: follow suggestion and avoid guessing student identifiers

examples.name: tutor-status
examples.safety: Read-only sample command using non-production student data.

examples.name: admin-summary
examples.safety: Read-only aggregate command with bounded output.

safety_notes: Do not include real student data in examples or manifests.
Expose tutor, memory, scheduler, and admin data through read-only commands first.
Keep nanogo as a downstream consumer example, not a clikit dependency.
